heading: EXT. TELEGRAPH OFFICE, PRAIRIE JUNCTION - DAY

units.text: EXT. TELEGRAPH OFFICE, PRAIRIE JUNCTION - DAY
A single-room telegraph shack beside the railroad water tower, its porch sagging.
Heat shimmers off the tracks.
A pinto horse is tied to the rail, flicking flies.
Inside the open door, EZEKIEL "ZEKE" MORROW (50s, stationmaster, sleeve garters, thick spectacles) sits at the key.
The sounder chatters.
He copies down a message, then looks up as hoofbeats thunder in.

TOMAS ESQUIVEL (20s, deputy, hat low) swings off his horse, ties it badly, and bursts onto the porch, while behind him a lean stranger, WILHELMINA "BILLIE" TATE (30s, drover's coat, a rifle in the crook of her arm) rides up slowly and stays in the saddle, watching the street.
Zeke! Is it true?
units.name: TOMAS

units.text: Sit down, son.
units.name: ZEKE

units.text: Is it true they're coming here?
units.name: TOMAS

units.text: The sounder chatters again.
Zeke raises a hand for quiet, writes, and then reads aloud.
Tower says the Harlan gang crossed the river an hour ago.
units.name: ZEKE

units.text: Hold the junction. Do not engage. Repeat, do not engage.
units.name: DISPATCHER
paren: over the wire, read aloud by Zeke

units.text: Do not engage? They'll burn the depot.
units.name: TOMAS

units.text: Billie dismounts, walks up the steps, and without a word takes the telegram from Zeke's hand and reads it.
Tomas stares at her rifle.
Zeke takes off his spectacles and wipes them on his sleeve.
Where's the sheriff?
units.name: BILLIE

units.text: Dead. Fever, three days back.
units.name: TOMAS

units.text: Then you're the law.
units.name: BILLIE

units.text: I'm twenty-two.
units.name: TOMAS

units.text: Today you're the law.
units.name: BILLIE

units.text: A rider appears at the end of the street, then another, then five.
Dust rises behind them.
Tomas draws his pistol and his hand shakes.
Zeke slides under the desk.
Billie raises the rifle, levels it, and fires once.
The lead horse rears, and the riders scatter behind the water tower.
You hit him!
units.name: TOMAS

units.text: I hit the horse. Don't thank me yet.
units.name: BILLIE

units.text: Silence.
Then a white handkerchief appears on a rifle barrel from behind the tower.
Is that what I think it is?
units.name: ZEKE

units.text: Somebody wants to talk.
units.name: BILLIE

units.text: Tomas lets out a breath that is almost a laugh.
Billie lowers the rifle but does not unload it.
